parsed.explanation: Combined national Penal Code and state Sharia regimes criminalise same-sex conduct and, for Muslims, gender nonconformity, with imprisonment, whipping and detention documented. Police and religious officers have raided queer venues repeatedly, including the November 2025 sauna raid arresting 208 men including 31 foreign nationals, with delayed release despite a magistrate rejecting remand. State-sanctioned targeting of trans people, hunt for a trans woman, rehabilitation programme, documented killings and custody sexual violence, and impunity/blackmail exposure coexist with no anti-discrimination or hate-crime protection. Federal-court rulings struck only some state provisions on federalism grounds; the Penal Code and cross-dressing prohibition remain. Tourists are rarely targeted and private enforcement is uncommon, keeping this above severe-risk anchors, but organised state coercion places it at high risk.

entry_documents.exposure: No explicit trans-visitor visa rule documented. Penal Code applies to tourists; 2001 deportation remark concerned gay foreign officials. Gender-marker changes for residents routinely rejected, but visitor passport practice not documented.
entry_documents.protection: Not documented. No documented acceptance of foreign trans documents or nonbinary markers.
entry_documents.interaction: No explicit visa rule does not remove Penal Code, raid, detention or Sharia exposure once identity or conduct is discovered.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: 2025 sauna raid arrested 208 men under s377B, leaked identities, suspended civil servants, delayed release despite magistrate rejecting remand; over 130 held including 31 foreigners. Male-ward sexual violence and prison terms of months to years documented.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Magistrate rejected remand extension and legal aid mobilised bailors, but release was delayed and no systemic remedy documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Venue raid leads to investigation, prolonged detention and birth-sex/male custody risk; embassies intervened for foreign nationals.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: All 13 states bar Muslim men dressing as women, three also bar women posing as men, with no definition of trans dressing; penalties up to 3 years, fine and caning. No trans-specific public-facility access rule documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Federal court struck Selangor s28 and 16 Kelantan provisions on constitutional/federalism grounds; High Court denied challenge to cross-dressing prohibition.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: State Sharia enforcement by religious departments operates alongside national Penal Code; court rulings did not decriminalise either regime.

care_services.exposure: Discriminatory denial of health care documented; 1982 ungazetted fatwa reported to end sex-reassignment surgery for Muslims. Court-ordered religious rehabilitation up to 6 months, extended to 1 year in Terengganu. No visitor medication or emergency-care rule documented.
care_services.interaction: Custody or court-ordered rehabilitation can interrupt care; HRT import, refill and emergency ward placement for visitors are not documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Penal Code s377A/B up to 20 years plus mandatory whipping and s377D gross indecency up to 2 years. Minister gave religious department full licence against trans people in 2020; 122 officers hunted a trans woman in 2021; conversion therapy openly promoted.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National home-affairs minister floated revisiting provisions in December 2025; no repeal documented. Hate-speech code covers sexual orientation, not a trans-protection remedy.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Sodomy and indecency laws function as documented police/religious lever in venue raids and state targeting, not merely dead-letter law.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented. No youth-specific health-care, medication, school, custody or family-travel finding in dossier.
minors_guardians.interaction: Adult criminal, detention and rehabilitation exposure would affect a guardian, but no age-specific rule documented; do not infer one.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Three trans women killed in under two months in 2019; police mistreatment and impunity documented. 2011 strip-search and sexual assault by religious officials and repeated arrests documented. No later killing documented after 2019.
street_violence_police_response.protection: No hate-crime or anti-discrimination protection documented. Legal aid sometimes assists, but no documented effective prosecution of attackers.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police and religious officers are perpetrators or enforcers in documented cases, reducing recourse for street or custody violence.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Censorship of LGBT events/media, rehabilitation retreats with 1,733 attendees by 2021, and episodic raids from 2018-2025 show continuing institutional hostility.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have provided partial federalism relief and magistrate rejected one remand, but Penal Code, cross-dressing law and enforcement practice remain.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Partial judicial checks do not cancel combined national-state enforcement; unknowns on visitor documents, medication, facilities and minor-specific rules are not evidence of safety.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: repeated police/religious raids, detention and sexual harassment in custody, officials framing trans people as offenders, weak legal-aid remedy. This dossier has additional statutory cross-dressing offences and 20-year Penal Code maximum, but enforcement against tourists is episodic rather than routine street sweeps.

Higher/safer than 0.15-A: no documented regular street sweeps convicting visitors for presentation alone, no routine months-long imprisonment for trans presentation, and tourists rarely targeted in private conduct. Custody sexual violence and state targeting prevent a higher score.

Materially lower than 0.35-A: anchors there have no offence of being trans and a single unremedied facility rule. Here there are criminal penalties, documented state targeting, a 208-person raid including foreigners, killings with impunity and no hate-crime protection.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime combines national criminalisation applicable to everyone, state Sharia cross-dressing offences applicable to Muslims, and police-religious enforcement in queer venues. Court federalism victories and episodic legal aid show some checks, but they have not removed the laws or prevented prolonged detention after the 2025 raid. Social and institutional framing treats gender diversity as an enforcement target, rehabilitation is state-funded, and violence lacks documented protective response. Infrequent targeting of tourists moderates frequency, not severity if outed. Minors have no documented separate exposure, so adult combined-regime risk governs.
